title: The stocktake afternoon, asked on Telegram: the assistant drafts and the advisor edits and sends
demonstrates: A drafts-only channel: the draft is correct and plain; the east shop's lead advisor keeps its facts and rewrites it in her own voice, twice. Both outcomes are sent_edited.

customer.name: Patsy Greer
customer.note: a regular of the Bonny Oaks shop; 2013 Buick Enclave; rear brakes were recommended at her last visit

named_in_a_line.name: Josh Tipton
named_in_a_line.role: the other advisor at Bonny Oaks, offered for the Friday

scenario.who_writes: A regular who writes to Angie by name.
scenario.what_happens: She asks to drop the car off on the stocktake afternoon. Angie turns the draft's 'closed' into two times with her on the Wednesday before, or the Friday with Josh (her week off starts on the Thursday), and her second message is the summary.

facts.booked: the Wednesday of week W+1, 13:00 at east; ERP appointment, source messenger

timeline.text: Morning Angie! Can I drop the Buick off the 19th after lunch for those back brakes

Good morning! On Thursday the 19th all our shops close at noon for inventory, so we can't take the car in that afternoon. That morning we're open from 7:30, and the rest of the week is regular hours, 7:30 to 5:30. Would a morning drop-off work for you?
timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

timeline.text:
Good morning, Patsy! Thursday the 19th we close at noon for inventory, so the afternoon's out. If it were my car I wouldn't put those rear brakes off much longer anyway. I can take the Buick Wednesday the 18th at 7:30 or 1:00, or Josh can have it Friday the 20th at 1:00. Which is easier for you, Patsy?
Angie
Thank you, Patsy. Wednesday the 18th at 1:00 works. See you then!
timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

timeline.text:
You're all set, Patsy: Wednesday the 18th at 1:00, rear brakes on the Enclave, here at Bonny Oaks. I'll message you when it's ready, should be by 4.
Angie

truth.reason: to book or ask for a slot
truth.outcome: booked for the day before the stocktake, 13:00, at east; resolved by slot 16
facts: the shop closes at 12:00 on the stocktake day, so the afternoon she asked for is not possible
slot 16 offered the day before at 7:30 or 1:00 with her, or the Friday at 1:00 with Josh: she books nobody to herself inside the week she has asked off (card S05)

why: The draft and what Angie sent say the same facts. Hers has the customer's name twice, 'if it were my car', two times to choose from, and her name at the end.
Her second message is the summary: day, time, work, car, shop.
new_facts: Patsy Greer, a regular of the Bonny Oaks shop, 2013 Buick Enclave, rear brakes recommended at her last visit; an appointment on the Wednesday of week W+1 at 13:00.
Angie offers no time of her own inside the week she has asked off (S5): the Wednesday before it with her, or the Friday with Josh (slot 17).
The contact's picture: a white Buick Enclave under a carport.
